question: What exactly does each blueprint star (1★→6★) do to a WEAPON's displayed DMG and to an ARMOR piece's Max HP / Psi Intensity in Once Human, as a multiplier table? Are tier (I–V) and stars independent multiplicative factors? Does Epic cap at 5★ and Legendary at 6★? Do stars change anything else?
verdict: Implement stars as a rarity-dependent LINEAR bonus on the 1★ value (additive steps of the base, not compounding), as a factor that is independent of and multiplied with the blueprint-tier (I–V) factor, applied ONLY to weapon DMG (per projectile) and to armor HP and Psi Intensity: displayed = round(base_T1_1★ × tierMult × starMult). Star tables: Legendary (cap 6★): 1.00 / 1.05 / 1.10 / 1.15 / 1.20 / 1.25. Epic (cap 5★): 1.00 / 1.06 / 1.11 / 1.17 / 1.22 (= +5.5%/star rounded to whole percent). Rare (cap 4★): 1.00 / 1.06 / 1.13 / 1.19. Standard/common (cap 3★): 1.00 / 1.07 / 1.14. The Legendary table is verified for weapons (DE.50 Jaws Tier I 128 → 160 at 6★; 17 in-game Tier-V 6★ weapon cards equal the Tier-V 1★ DMG × 1.25 exactly) and for armor (per-star table at every tier; fandom Lonewolf Hood Tier VI 925 = OHDB Tier-V 740 × 1.25). The Epic/Rare/Standard tables are verified for ARMOR by two independent datasets (legacy per-star table and 2026 in-game OCR: epic 5★ = OHDB T5 × 1.22 for all six slots) plus fandom Raid Helmet (rare) ×1.189 at 4★; for EPIC WEAPONS no per-star sample exists, so use 1.22 at 5★ by analogy and expose a toggle to flat 1.20. Stars do NOT change Pollution Resist (constant 21/28 across all stars), fire rate, magazine, crit rate, crit DMG, weakspot DMG, range, reload, special-effect values or set bonuses (6★ cards show identical FR/MAG/CR/CD/WS to 1★). Claim (B) 1.0…1.5 is a hard-coded placeholder in the lReDragol calculator, contradicted by every dataset; claim (C) '~4%/star' is the relative step of model (A) (5/105…5/120 = 4.8%→4.2%) and '1★ vs 3★ 10–15%' = +10%. Tier factors to combine with: armor HP ×1 / 1.3333 / 2.6667 / 5.3333 / 9.8333 (legacy; since v2.3.1 Tier-V HP is rebased ×1.2542, i.e. 12.333× Tier I, Psi unchanged), armor Psi ×1 / 1.5 / 2.375 / 3.75 / 5.75; weapon DMG ×1 / 1.547 / 2.469 / 3.859 / 5.867 (Tier I→V). IMPORTANT CORRECTION: OHDB's displayed weapon DMG (Jaws 494, Wildfire 444, Last Valor 174, Bullseye 1216) is the TIER IV 1★ value; Tier V 1★ = OHDB × 1.52 (751 / 675 / 264 / 1848). The planner's '≈3.85× Tier I→Tier V' is actually Tier I→Tier IV.

alternativesToExpose: Star table mode (default = rarity-specific): Legendary 1.00/1.05/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25; Epic 1.00/1.06/1.11/1.17/1.22; Rare 1.00/1.06/1.13/1.19; Standard 1.00/1.07/1.14  vs  'uniform +5% of 1★ per star for every rarity' (Epic 5★ = 1.20). Only Epic WEAPONS are unverified; both modes give identical Legendary results.
Legacy 'lReDragol' mode: 1.0/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 (6★ = ×1.50) — keep only as a labelled reference toggle; contradicted by every dataset.
Compounding mode ~4%/star (1.04^(star−1), 6★ ≈ 1.217) — reproduces the Steam '4% per star' anecdote; not recommended.
Rounding of the displayed stat: Math.round(base × tier × star) (matches 30×1.25→38, 1110×1.25→1388) vs round-half-even (OCR shows 370×1.25→462); affects ±1 HP/DMG only.

Weapon tier basis: treat OHDB/saitoh/lReDragol DMG as Tier IV 1★ and derive Tier V 1★ = ×1.52 (Jaws 751, Wildfire 675, Last Valor 264, Bullseye 1848) [default]  vs  treat it as Tier V (planner's current assumption).
Armor HP basis: legacy Tier-V 1★ (legendary helmet 590) vs post-v2.3.1 Tier-V 1★ (740 = ×1.2542, all rarities; Psi unchanged; Pollution 12/16). Default post-2.3.1 for the live game.
notes: METHOD: read verbatim the lReDragol all_armor_stats.json / mechanics.py / player.py / weapon_list.json / items_and_sets.json, saitoh183 weapons.json+armor.json, TeeReckzi/OHMM OHDB reference JSON, 0x91CEA55 raw.json + INGAME_KNOWLEDGE_BIBLE.md, nohvenell2 Korean armor dump; computed all implied ratios with Python (script output kept in the scratchpad). Game sites (fandom, game8, wikily, OHDB, Steam, translate.goog mirrors, 0x91cea55.github.io) are blocked, so their numbers come from 15 search-engine snippets quoted above; GitHub API tree listing was refused and GitHub code search returned nothing new. KEY FINDINGS: (1) Stars are linear in the 1★ base, applied per tier identically (every lower-tier row in the legacy table equals base × tierMult × starMult), so tier and star are independent multiplicative factors. (2) Legendary 6★ = ×1.25 holds for weapons (Jaws 128→160; 17 in-game 6★ cards = T5 1★ × 1.25) and armor HP and Psi (legacy table; 0x91 OCR 925/740; fandom Lonewolf Hood 925). (3) The per-star step depends on rarity — the max-star totals are +25% (Legendary 6★), +22% (Epic 5★), +19% (Rare 4★), +14% (Standard 3★); Epic 5★ = 1.22 is confirmed for armor by two independent datasets (legacy table 648/531; 2026 OCR 813/666, 2113/1732, 1950/1598, 1625/1332 all = 1.220) and Rare 4★ = 1.19 by fandom Raid Helmet (352/296). Epic weapons at 5★ have no direct sample (medium confidence for the 1.22 value; the cap of 5★ itself is high confidence). (4) Nothing else scales with stars: Pollution Resist is flat across stars in all 24 slot×rarity series; FR/MAG/CR/CD/WS on 6★ cards equal 1★ values; no source links stars to special-effect values, set bonuses or mod slots (differences such as Jaws 'every 3 hits' vs older 'every 4 shots' are patch changes, not stars). (5) Side finding affecting the planner's weapon data: OHDB's displayed DMG is the Tier IV value (Jaws 494 = fandom/game8 Tier IV; Wildfire 444 = Tier IV; Last Valor 174 = wikily Tier-4 item page), so the '3.85× Tier I→Tier V' in research/weapons.md is Tier I→Tier IV; Tier V 1★ = OHDB × 1.52 and Tier I→V ≈ ×5.867 for guns (Jaws 751/128, Last Valor 264/45). The 0x91 'T5/6-Star' OCR values = Tier V 1★ × 1.25 (e.g. 939 = 751 × 1.25), with no residual calibration factor. (6) Side finding on armor: OHDB 'Durability 400' rows (helmet 740, mask 370, top 1924, pants 1776, gloves 1110, shoes 1480; epic 666/333/1732/1598/999/1332; rare 592/…; common 518/…) are post-v2.3.1 Tier V 1★ values = legacy × 1.2542 for ALL rarities (so not a 6★ factor, contrary to research/armor.md §5), Psi unchanged, Pollution rebased to 12/16; max-star values in the live game are therefore legendary 740×1.25 = 925 and epic 666×1.22 = 813. (7) 0x91 raw.json keys its epic max-star row as '6' but the value is the 5★ factor (1.22) — a schema label, not evidence of a 6★ Epic. NOT FOUND: an explicit official per-star table; intermediate-star DMG samples for any weapon (only the 1★ and 6★ Jaws endpoints and 6★ cards for 17 legendaries); any Epic/Rare weapon per-star sample; Starchrom per-star costs are out of scope here (see research/calibration.md §6).
